title: Galaxy Note 20 5G "waiting to connect" BLE authentication errors
symptom: On a Galaxy Note 20 5G with Android 10, xDrip nightly build edd2c2a-2020.09.04 never gets past 'waiting to connect' message when attempting to authenticate with a 8K0### series transmitter. Repeating errors show in event list: 'authentication notification throwable: (CHECK_AUTH) com.polidea.rxandroidble2.exceptions.BleDisconnectedException: Disconnected from MAX=XX:XX:XX:XX:XX:XX with status 19 (GATT_CONN_TERMINATE_PEER_USER)'.
fix: The issue was resolved by updating to the 2020.10.01 nightly build. The user reported: 'Fixed with 2020.10.01 nightly build, see above comment screenshots'.
evidence_quote: Fixed with 2020.10.01 nightly build, see above comment screenshots
